stories.title: LIV Golf's Oct. 25 Deadline — 10 Days Left for Players to Choose

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
10 days left. ⏳

LIV Golf's Oct. 25 player deadline is closing in. BC Partners committed initial funding toward a $300M restructuring — but 50% of players by claim value must sign with LIV 2.0.

Jon Rahm already said no. Who else walks?

#LIVGolf #GolfNews

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Bryson DeChambeau's agency disputes a $1.2M claim in LIV Golf's bankruptcy. 👀

Court approved rejecting 19 player contracts: DeChambeau, Dustin Johnson, Bubba Watson, Poulter, Westwood.

The Oct. 25 deadline looms.

#LIVGolf #BrysonDeChambeau

stories.title: Buick LPGA Shanghai Opens Today — Thitikul Defending Title

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
The defending champion is in town. 🏆

Atthaya Thitikul opens the Buick LPGA Shanghai today — coming off her fourth LPGA win of 2026 at the LOTTE Championship.

She birdied 17 and 18 under pressure to seal it. Now she defends.

#LPGATour #BuickLPGA

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Four LPGA wins in 2026. Tied for the season lead. Defending champion this week. 🔥

Atthaya Thitikul is the first Thai woman in a decade to win four or more LPGA events in a single season.

She tees off in Shanghai today.

#LPGATour #Thitikul

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:

He's playing the Abu Dhabi Championship on the DP World Tour this fall.

Where does Rahm play in 2027?

#JonRahm #LIVGolf

Wind. Ocean. Bermuda.

stories.title: Scheffler's 178 Weeks at No. 1 — The Quest Continues, Tiger's Record Still Distant

x_posts.label: Post 7
x_posts.text:
Scottie Scheffler is closing in on 178 consecutive weeks at world No. 1. 🏅

Tiger Woods' record: 281 weeks (2005–2010).

To break it, Scheffler must hold No. 1 until October 2028 — about two years away.

The hunt continues.

#ScottieScheffler #OWGR

x_posts.label: Post 8
x_posts.text:
The gap between Scheffler and No. 2 McIlroy in the world rankings? About 400 points. 📊

That's not dominance. That's a different orbit.

Unless injury intervenes, this streak isn't ending anytime soon.

#ScottieScheffler #GolfRankings
